summary.headline: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR 53.8 crore; standalone revenue up 7.8% YoY to INR 42 crore, Ind AS EBITDA margin 56.3% consolidated.
summary.overview: Standalone workspace revenue rose 7.8% YoY to INR 42 crore, with consolidated revenue at INR 53.8 crore and Ind AS consolidated EBITDA up 14.7% to INR 30.3 crore. Operational portfolio grew to 1.13 million sq ft (17,294 seats, 27 centers, 12 cities) with occupancy at 91.93%. Post-quarter, the company raised INR 100 crore of 11.75% secured NCDs (36 months) and encumbered about 19.65% of equity, with promoter holding stated at 36.81%. Management highlighted a pipeline of 2.31 million sq ft signed for future consumption, though analyst questions on Ahmedabad per-sq-ft economics, lease-inclusive leverage and Q4 margin drop were answered only partially.

segments.name: Managed workspace (standalone)
segments.commentary: INR 42 crore revenue, recurring; occupied seats 15,899 vs 12,534 YoY; occupancy 91.93% vs 88.6%. Enterprise clients ~70% of revenue vs 52% a year ago; revenue-to-rent 2.63x.

segments.name: Needle & Thread (design and build)
segments.commentary: Balance of consolidated revenue (about INR 11.8 crore implied), one-time in nature and booked on project completion/milestone under Ind AS. FY26 one-time revenue was INR 57 crore per management.

segments.name: Tier 2 cities
segments.commentary: About 80% of operational SBA in Tier 2 cities, contributing ~74% of standalone revenue in the quarter.

guidance_outlook: Management expects revenue from signed capacity to progressively show up as centers move into operation; no numerical revenue guidance given.

Ahmedabad development-management project (~8.6 lakh sq ft, Ambli Bopal Road): fit-out capex ~INR 100 crore, expected ~8,500 seats and ~INR 120 crore revenue potential once handed over; no timeline stated.
Total identified portfolio ~3.63 million sq ft across 40 centers with 52,000+ operational seats; FY27 framed as year of executing signed assets and expanding into new territories.
INR 100 crore NCD to reflect in financials from Q2 onwards; ~INR 55 crore of existing debt repaid.
Global tokenization platform being set up outside India; entity incorporation commenced, no timeline given.
capex_capacity: Operational 1.13 million sq ft; 0.19 million sq ft under fit-out; 2.31 million sq ft signed for future consumption (total identified ~3.63 million sq ft, 40 centers).

Management said ~12 lakh sq ft operational area of which ~75% is company-built, roughly 9 lakh sq ft at ~INR 1,300/sq ft, i.e., ~INR 118 crore of fit-out investment to date (excluding refurbishment and deposits on future sites).
Development-management model covers ~1.4 million sq ft across Ahmedabad and Jaipur.
New-center ramp: 75-90 days from handover to client fit-out; ~6-9 months to maturity, per management.
Management said unspent IPO proceeds are still with the company and will be deployed as properties under construction are handed over.
demand_pricing: Ahmedabad realisations management cited at INR 100-125 per sq ft per month for a full operating year; Capital One (~3.15 lakh sq ft, 95% pre-leased) became operational toward end FY26.
Analyst's implied Capital One figure of ~INR 1,044/sq ft/yr was reconciled by management to ~INR 87/sq ft/month in year one, reflecting rent-free and fit-out periods; 8-9 billable months assumed.
Enterprise/GCC demand: management said it is in talks with clients for full-spectrum GCC solutions in Bangalore and Hyderabad.
Scalex Advisory (GCC full-service JV, ~12% stake held by DevX) to focus on GIFT City; managed-office GCC leads to be redirected to DevX.

qa_highlights.question: Shubham Padhiyar (Chhattisgarh Investments) asked why Mumbai Central revenue fell from INR 14 crore to INR 11 crore despite Noida revenue rising, given a Noida centre closure.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the Noida centre closed at the very end of FY26 after litigation, and that Noida (three centres) did about INR 11.5 crore operational revenue before closure, with roughly INR 4.5 crore now lost from the closed centre. The analyst's figures were disputed (INR 9 crore vs INR 11.5-12 crore), and the reconciliation was deferred to email.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst's implied Capital One revenue of about INR 1,050 per sq ft per year (INR 2.7-3 crore a month on ~3.15 lakh sq ft) versus Ahmedabad portfolio at about INR 2,500 per sq ft per year.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Ahmedabad realisations are INR 100-125 per sq ft per month (about INR 1,200-1,500 a year), and that INR 2,500 a year is not the right figure. The INR 1,044 figure equals about INR 87 per sq ft per month in year one, reflecting rent-free and fit-out periods; management assumed 8-9 billable months. Management declined to confirm the analyst's FY26 Ahmedabad revenue of about INR 78 crore and asked for an email.

qa_highlights.question: What share of revenue is recurring versus one-time, and how much capex has been spent on the 1.13 million sq ft portfolio?
qa_highlights.answer: Of INR 53.8 crore consolidated revenue, INR 42 crore is managed office (recurring) and the balance is Needle & Thread one-time revenue. FY26 Needle & Thread one-time revenue was INR 57 crore. About 75% of the ~12 lakh sq ft is company-built, roughly 9 lakh sq ft at about INR 1,300 per sq ft, i.e. about INR 118 crore of fit-out investment, excluding refurbishment and deposits on future sites.

qa_highlights.question: Mukul Bhushan (Raru Family Office) asked to disclose lease-inclusive leverage each quarter: debt-to-equity ~2x and ROCE ~9% including about INR 226 crore of lease liability, versus the presented 0.78x and 14%.
qa_highlights.answer: Parin Shah did not confirm or refute the lease-inclusive figures. He explained the ROCE/ROE lag: 75-90 days from handover to fit-out and client onboarding, and 6-9 months to maturity. He said ROCE is 14% and ROE 7%, and that unspent IPO funds will be deployed as under-construction properties are handed over.

qa_highlights.question: Why did standalone EBITDA margin fall to 59.2% in Q4 from 64% a year earlier, and should the FY27 model use 60.5% or 59.2%?
qa_highlights.answer: Parin Shah attributed the Q4 drop to expenses he described as one-time in nature, and said it was not a structural margin decline. He cited standalone Ind AS margin of 66% in Q1 and peer margins of 60-65%. Consolidated margin is lower because Needle & Thread books revenue on project completion or milestone under Ind AS. No FY27 margin figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: How does the Scalex Advisory non-compete work, what is DevX's stake, and can DevX still do GCC business?
qa_highlights.answer: Umesh Uttamchandani said Scalex is a JV of DevX, Savvy (GIFT City developer) and Talati & Talati, with DevX holding about 12%. It targets full-spectrum GCC solutions, limited to GIFT City, and standalone managed-office leads are redirected to DevX. DevX continues GCC business (payroll and facility management) and is in talks for GCC solutions in Bangalore and Hyderabad.

risks_watch: Revenue reconciliation gaps: city-wise and Ahmedabad revenue figures disputed on the call and deferred to email; watch for the written responses and whether they close the gap.

Lease-inclusive leverage: the analyst's estimate of about 2x debt/equity and about 9% ROCE including about INR 226 crore of lease liabilities was not answered. Management asked for quarterly disclosure of this view to be declined; watch whether it is added.

Ramp execution: 2.31 million sq ft signed but not yet operational, with 0.19 million sq ft under fit-out. Revenue conversion timelines (75-90 days to handover-fit-out, 6-9 months to maturity) are long, and no revenue timeline for the Ahmedabad 8.6 lakh sq ft project was given.

Debt and promoter pledge: INR 100 crore 11.75% NCD over 36 months from Q2; about 19.65% of equity encumbered; promoter holding 36.81% (about 37.29% after warrant conversion) against a 19.65% covenant floor. Watch for any changes to covenants or pledge levels.

Margin trajectory: Q4 FY26 standalone margin of 59.2% vs 64% a year earlier was attributed to one-time expenses without quantification. Consolidated Ind AS margin of 56.3% is diluted by Needle & Thread's milestone-based revenue recognition.

Early-stage new ventures: tokenisation platform outside India (no timeline), AI infrastructure launchpad, and Scalex (operations only just starting, GIFT City focus). Monitor incorporation and any capital commitments.
key_quotes: So the operational number although being 1.12 million square feet, there is an additional 0.19 million square feet, which is under fit out.
It is important to note that this is not a borrowed money, there is no bank, no loan, and no repayment schedule attached to it.
Against this requirement, the current promoter shareholding is 36.81%, which is significantly above the prescribed minimum requirement.
I would appreciate if you can reach out to our email address of Investor Relations team and we would be happy to address those questions.
summary.management_tone: Confident on portfolio growth, occupancy and the signed pipeline, but defensive and evasive when pressed on city-level revenue, Ahmedabad per-sq-ft economics, lease-inclusive leverage and the Q4 margin fall. Several specific questions were deferred to email follow-up.
